known_text: He's going to ask you tomorrow.

use.known: He's going to ask you about the meeting tomorrow morning.
use.target: 他明天早上会问你开会的东西。

use.known: She said he wants to watch a film with us this weekend.
use.target: 她说他想这个周末和我们看电影。

use.known: If he has time on Sunday, he will come to see us.
use.target: 如果他星期天有时间，他会来见我们。

use.known: I hope he can tell us what happened at work yesterday.
use.target: 我希望他可以告诉我们昨天工作发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone wants him to explain what he is trying to do.
use.target: 大家都想他解释他在试着做什么。

use.known: Will he be able to come to the meeting on Saturday?
use.target: 他星期六可以来开会吗？

use.known: He's going to ask you about it tomorrow at the office.
use.target: 他明天会在办公室问你。

use.known: She wants to meet us tomorrow evening for a film.
use.target: 她想明天晚上和我们见看电影。

use.known: If you have time tomorrow, we can go out together.
use.target: 如果你明天有时间，我们可以一起出去。

use.known: I am going to tell him the good news tomorrow morning.
use.target: 我明天早上会告诉他好的消息。

use.known: Everyone wants to finish the work before tomorrow.
use.target: 大家都想明天之前完成工作。

use.known: Will you be able to come to the meeting tomorrow?
use.target: 你明天可以来开会吗？

use.known: He's going to ask you about what happened yesterday.
use.target: 他会问你昨天发生了什么。

use.known: She said she will come to see us tomorrow evening.
use.target: 她说她明天晚上会来见我们。

use.known: If you work hard, you will be able to finish on time.
use.target: 如果你努力工作，你会按时完成。

use.known: I think he will want to watch the football on Sunday.
use.target: 我觉得他星期天会想看足球。

use.known: Everyone thinks we will have a good time this weekend.
use.target: 大家都觉得我们这个周末会过得开心。

use.known: Will she be able to explain what went wrong at work?
use.target: 她会解释工作出了什么问题吗？

use.known: He's going to ask you what we should do about it.
use.target: 他会问你我们要怎么做。

use.known: She wants to ask us about the meeting tomorrow.
use.target: 她想问我们明天开会的东西。

use.known: If you don't understand, you should ask someone.
use.target: 如果你不了解，你要问人。

use.known: I am going to ask him what happened at the office.
use.target: 我会问他办公室发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone is asking what we are going to do next.
use.target: 大家都在问我们下一步要做什么。

use.known: Will you ask her what time the meeting starts?
use.target: 你会问她开会什么时候开始吗？

use.known: He's going to ask you about it when he sees you.
use.target: 他见你的时候会问你。

use.known: She told me she wants to see you this weekend.
use.target: 她告诉我她这个周末想见你。

use.known: If you have time, I want to talk with you tomorrow.
use.target: 如果你有时间，我明天想和你说话。

use.known: I hope you had a good time watching the football.
use.target: 我希望你看足球过得开心。

use.known: Everyone wants to tell you about what happened.
use.target: 大家都想告诉你发生了什么。

use.known: Will they ask you to help with the work tomorrow?
use.target: 他们明天会问你帮忙工作吗？
